description.en: A bowl of home. Restores 40 energy.
description.id: Semangkuk kehangatan. Memulihkan 40 energi.

description.en: Simple, golden, lovely. Restores 32 energy.
description.id: Sederhana dan lezat. Memulihkan 32 energi.

description.en: Flavors of the forest. Restores 55 energy.
description.id: Cita rasa hutan. Memulihkan 55 energi.

description.en: A slow evening by the lake. Restores 45 energy.
description.id: Malam tenang di danau. Memulihkan 45 energi.

description.en: Summer, saved in a jar. Restores 24 energy.
description.id: Musim panas dalam toples. Memulihkan 24 energi.

description.en: Place on your farm to water every planted tile each dawn.
description.id: Pasang di kebun untuk menyiram semua tanaman setiap pagi.

description.en: A friendly guardian. Crops gain one bonus growth day when placed.
description.id: Penjaga kebun. Tanaman mendapat bonus satu hari pertumbuhan saat dipasang.

description.en: Five flowers, one thoughtful gift.
description.id: Lima bunga, satu hadiah penuh makna.

description.en: A promise for a villager with eight hearts.
description.id: Janji untuk warga yang sudah memiliki delapan hati.

description.en: Turn a little corn into a week of happy mornings.
description.id: Ubah jagung menjadi pakan untuk pagi yang bahagia.

description.en: Grandmother left you more than a farm. Plant 3 seeds and begin your own little chapter.
description.id: Nenek meninggalkan lebih dari sekadar kebun. Tanam 3 benih dan mulai kisahmu.

description.en: Harvest 5 crops. Every small beginning deserves a little celebration.
description.id: Panen 5 tanaman. Setiap awal kecil layak dirayakan.

description.en: Meet six neighbours. A home is made of the people who share it.
description.id: Kenali enam tetangga. Orang-oranglah yang membuat rumah terasa hangat.

description.en: Earn 1,000 gold from shipping. The valley is ready to taste what you have grown.
description.id: Hasilkan 1.000 emas dari pengiriman. Lembah menanti hasil kebunmu.

description.en: Bring 20 timber and 15 stone to repair the old village bridge.
description.id: Bawa 20 kayu dan 15 batu untuk memperbaiki jembatan desa.

description.en: Craft 3 things and bring 6 copper ore. Help Orin restore the community greenhouse.
description.id: Buat 3 barang dan bawa 6 bijih tembaga. Bantu Orin memperbaiki rumah kaca.

description.en: Share a feast: 5 crops, 3 fresh eggs, a trout and a bouquet. Bring light back to Dewhaven.
description.id: Siapkan perjamuan: 5 lobak, 3 telur, seekor trout dan buket bunga. Terangi Dewhaven lagi.

description.en: Mira needs 3 turnips for a neighbor who cannot make it to the market.
description.id: Mira perlu 3 lobak untuk tetangga yang tak bisa pergi ke pasar.

description.en: Bring Cleo 3 eggs. Tomorrow's breakfast is on you.
description.id: Bawakan 3 telur untuk Cleo. Sarapan besok berkat bantuanmu.

description.en: Bring Rowan 5 berries and 2 mushrooms for the woodland picnic.
description.id: Bawa 5 beri dan 2 jamur untuk piknik Rowan.

description.en: Catch 5 fish. Finn thinks you might be a natural.
description.id: Tangkap 5 ikan. Finn yakin kamu punya bakat.

description.en: Orin needs 8 iron ore for the town's new bell.
description.id: Orin perlu 8 bijih besi untuk lonceng desa.

description.en: A dozen daisies would brighten up the town hall. Bring 6.
description.id: Bunga daisy akan menghiasi balai desa. Bawakan 6 bunga.

description.en: Care for your animals 12 times. They notice every little kindness.
description.id: Rawat hewanmu 12 kali. Mereka mengingat setiap kebaikan.

description.en: Make 5 recipes. Good food brings people together.
description.id: Buat 5 resep. Makanan enak menyatukan orang.

description.en: Expand your growing patch. There is room for a bigger dream.
description.id: Perluas lahan tanam. Masih ada ruang untuk mimpi yang besar.

description.en: Bring Finn a moonfish, found at the lake after 6 pm.
description.id: Bawa ikan bulan untuk Finn. Ikan ini ada di danau setelah jam 6 sore.

description.en: A letter in the repaired greenhouse names a boatbuilder at Aster Quay. Follow the harbour road and find the other half of Grandmother's delivery ledger.
description.id: Surat di rumah kaca menyebut pembuat kapal di Dermaga Aster. Ikuti jalan pelabuhan untuk mencari separuh buku kiriman Nenek.

description.en: Three counterweights protect an old chart in the Tide Vault. Restore the mechanisms and recover the chart before the next harbour gathering.
description.id: Tiga penyeimbang melindungi peta di Ruang Pasang. Pulihkan mekanismenya dan ambil peta.

description.en: Visit Sunridge and harvest 40 crops in total. Tamsin wants the old delivery route to carry fresh food again, not just stories about better years.
description.id: Kunjungi Sunridge dan panen total 40 tanaman. Tamsin ingin jalur lama kembali membawa makanan segar.

description.en: Bring three jars of preserves and five ears of sweet corn. There is room for every neighbour at the orchard's first shared supper.
description.id: Bawa tiga selai dan lima jagung. Setiap tetangga mendapat tempat dalam makan bersama kebun.

description.en: Recover the lens from the Ember Gallery and craft eight things in total. Orin can fit the lens into the valley's old weather station.
description.id: Ambil lensa di Galeri Bara dan buat total delapan barang. Orin akan memasangnya pada stasiun cuaca tua.

description.en: Visit Briar Hollow and meet nine neighbours. Ilan has kept the last blank pages for people who still have somewhere to go.
description.id: Kunjungi Briar Hollow dan kenali sembilan tetangga. Ilan menyimpan halaman kosong untuk perjalanan baru.

description.en: Open the observatory's three shutters and recover its compass. Gather 25 ore in total to restore the old survey markers.
description.id: Buka tiga penutup observatorium dan ambil kompas. Kumpulkan total 25 bijih untuk penanda jalur.

description.en: Join three town gatherings and give eight thoughtful gifts. A road only matters when people have a reason to visit one another.
description.id: Ikuti tiga pertemuan kota dan berikan delapan hadiah. Jalan bermakna saat orang saling berkunjung.

description.en: Complete all three vaults and earn 10,000 gold from shipping. The atlas can finally leave the archive: its next chapter belongs to everyone.
description.id: Selesaikan tiga ruang penjelajahan dan hasilkan 10.000 emas dari pengiriman. Bab atlas berikutnya menjadi milik semua orang.

description.en: Sera needs twelve timber and four copper ore for a little delivery boat.
description.id: Sera membutuhkan dua belas kayu dan empat tembaga untuk kapal pengiriman.

description.en: Bring two lakeside dinners for the boatbuilders working late.
description.id: Bawa dua hidangan ikan untuk pembuat kapal.

description.en: Tamsin would like four jars of preserves for the winter pantry.
description.id: Tamsin membutuhkan empat selai untuk persediaan musim dingin.

description.en: Bring eight daisies for the next orchard picnic.
description.id: Bawa delapan bunga untuk piknik kebun berikutnya.

description.en: Bring three moon crystals for Ilan's magnifying instruments.
description.id: Bawa tiga kristal bulan untuk alat pembesar Ilan.

description.en: Bring two woodland stews for the volunteers repairing the archive.
description.id: Bawa dua semur hutan untuk para perawat arsip.

description.en: Share two friendship moments. Some stories need a little time together.
description.id: Bagikan dua momen pertemanan. Beberapa cerita membutuhkan waktu bersama.

description.en: Join six community gatherings across the new towns.
description.id: Ikuti enam pertemuan komunitas di kota-kota baru.

description.en: Recover the chart, lens and compass from all three vaults.
description.id: Temukan peta, lensa, dan kompas di tiga ruang penjelajahan.

dialogue.en: You can tell a lot about a person by the way they tend a garden. I think yours will be lovely.
dialogue.id: Kebun mencerminkan orang yang merawatnya. Kebunmu pasti akan indah.

dialogue.en: A little rain, a little patience. That is all a seed really asks of us.
dialogue.id: Sedikit hujan, sedikit kesabaran. Hanya itu yang diminta benih.

dialogue.en: Grandmother used to leave flowers by the old well. Maybe we can bring that tradition back.
dialogue.id: Nenek dulu menaruh bunga di sumur tua. Mungkin kita bisa menghidupkan tradisi itu kembali.

dialogue.en: The woods have their own rhythm. Walk slowly, and they will show you their secrets.
dialogue.id: Hutan punya iramanya sendiri. Berjalanlah perlahan untuk menemukan rahasianya.

dialogue.en: I marked a few berry bushes along the trail. Help yourself, but leave some for the birds.
dialogue.id: Aku menandai semak beri di jalur. Ambil secukupnya dan sisakan untuk burung.

dialogue.en: When the valley blooms again, I want to see it with someone who understands this place.
dialogue.id: Saat lembah kembali mekar, aku ingin melihatnya bersama orang yang memahami tempat ini.

dialogue.en: Your grandmother believed this valley could become a home for everyone. You have her spirit.
dialogue.id: Nenekmu percaya lembah ini bisa menjadi rumah bagi semua orang. Kamu mewarisi semangatnya.

dialogue.en: The old community garden has seen better days. Every harvest gets us a little closer.
dialogue.id: Kebun komunitas tua perlu dirawat. Setiap panen membawa kita lebih dekat.

dialogue.en: The Lantern Festival is our promise to one another: no one in Dewhaven is alone.
dialogue.id: Festival Lentera adalah janji kami: tak seorang pun di Dewhaven sendirian.

dialogue.en: Come in whenever you like. There is always room at my table, especially for a farmer.
dialogue.id: Mampirlah kapan saja. Selalu ada kursi di mejaku, terutama untuk seorang petani.

dialogue.en: Nothing beats cooking with something you grew yourself. Try the farmhouse omelet!
dialogue.id: Memasak hasil kebun sendiri rasanya paling enak. Cobalah omelet farm!

dialogue.en: I have a recipe for every season. The best ingredient is still good company.
dialogue.id: Aku punya resep untuk setiap musim. Bahan terbaik tetap teman yang baik.

dialogue.en: Watch the float, not the clock. The lake rewards a calm heart.
dialogue.id: Perhatikan pelampung, bukan jam. Danau menghargai hati yang tenang.

dialogue.en: After sunset, something silver glides beneath the lilies. A moonfish, if the stories are true.
dialogue.id: Setelah senja, sesuatu berwarna perak berenang di bawah teratai. Ikan bulan, menurut cerita.

dialogue.en: The bridge is a fine place to sit together and say absolutely nothing.
dialogue.id: Jembatan adalah tempat yang indah untuk duduk bersama tanpa berkata apa pun.

dialogue.en: Good tools deserve good hands. Bring me copper and we will give yours a little more strength.
dialogue.id: Alat bagus layak di tangan yang baik. Bawa tembaga agar alatmu semakin kuat.

dialogue.en: There is moonstone deep in the mine. Bring a full stomach and a steady pickaxe.
dialogue.id: Ada batu bulan di kedalaman tambang. Bawa perut kenyang dan beliung yang kuat.

dialogue.en: Stone remembers everything. This valley has a few stories left to tell.
dialogue.id: Batu mengingat segalanya. Lembah ini masih punya cerita untuk dibagikan.

dialogue.en: A boat is a promise that the shore is not the end of the world. I would like to build a good one.
dialogue.id: Kapal adalah janji bahwa pantai bukan akhir dunia. Aku ingin membuat kapal yang baik.

dialogue.en: Your grandmother kept the delivery ledger here. Every name had a little note beside it.
dialogue.id: Nenekmu menyimpan buku kiriman di sini. Setiap nama punya catatan kecil.

dialogue.en: I saved the smoothest piece of driftwood. There is a place for it in the new boat.
dialogue.id: Aku menyimpan kayu apung terhalus. Ada tempat untuknya di kapal baru.

dialogue.en: The orchard takes its time. I am learning to do the same. Come sit when your chores are done.
dialogue.id: Kebun tumbuh perlahan. Aku belajar mengikutinya. Mampirlah setelah pekerjaanmu selesai.

dialogue.en: We used to set one long table between the trees. Everyone brought something small.
dialogue.id: Dulu kami menata meja panjang di antara pohon. Semua membawa sesuatu.

dialogue.en: I planted a new row this morning. Some plans are worth waiting several seasons for.
dialogue.id: Aku menanam baris baru pagi ini. Beberapa rencana pantas ditunggu hingga beberapa musim.

dialogue.en: Maps remember where the roads went. Letters remember why anyone took them. We need both.
dialogue.id: Peta mengingat arah jalan. Surat mengingat alasan orang menempuhnya. Keduanya penting.

dialogue.en: The old observatory measured the seasons, not fortunes. Its lens has been missing for years.
dialogue.id: Observatorium tua mengukur musim, bukan nasib. Lensanya hilang bertahun-tahun.

dialogue.en: Leave a little space in every map. There should always be somewhere left to discover.
dialogue.id: Sisakan ruang di setiap peta. Selalu ada tempat yang belum ditemukan.
